scope: company master-data lists and their Row 5 company, chart, relationship, conversion, undo, seed, documentation, and browser integrations
coverage_scope: This inventory proves internal blueprint-to-witness coverage. It does not prove anchor completeness; the independent private-manual extract and human side-by-side comparison remain the Row 5 anchor-completeness gate.

notation.entry_rule: Every object in fields, validations, actions, seeds, and deferred_entries is an inventory entry. Every scalar member of an options, enum, search, filters, sorts, default_columns, or additional_columns array is also an entry and inherits the enclosing witness key w.

keys.io: input/output direction; rw, input, output, seed, or staged

child_field.docs: generated nested schema and command pages for {noun}

derived.schema: absence from writable columns plus source/index metadata where applicable

rule.schema: constraint/index/FK metadata or explicit service-only ownership assertion
rule.model: typed model validation where structurally expressible
rule.output: stable success, warning, or error code/details

deferred.schema: absence, nullable staged column, or unavailable marker as declared

validations.rule: root is level one and resulting subtree depth is at most five
parent change cannot create direct or indirect cycle

leaf/display name excludes colon and is at most 200 characters; normalized leaf key is at most 400; five-level visible full name is at most 1004 and normalized full-name key at most 2004; length errors are E_VALIDATION and active sibling collisions are E_NAME_TAKEN
rename/reparent validates the entire subtree and atomically recomputes path/full-name/depth without descendant versions or audit entries
activation requires active ancestors; deactivation with descendants requires explicit cascade and returns parent-first ids

money.input: canonical decimal string with optional ISO 4217 currency
money.storage: signed-64-bit integer minor units plus currency, all-null or all-present

exact_percent.storage: signed integer millionths of one percentage point

exact_quantity.rounding: decimal half-even once to six quantity decimals

noun_inheritance.rule: The inherited reusable entries are part of every matching noun exactly as if repeated in its fields, validations, options, defaults, and actions arrays.

global_validations.rule: all primary display keys are trimmed, NFC-normalized, case-folded, reject colon, and are at most 200 characters with normalized leaf keys at most 400; hierarchical full names/keys are bounded at 1004/2004
suggestions and id/name resolution expose only authorized records and inaccessible equals missing
foreign keys restrict deletion and are indexed; polymorphic type/id pairs are validated in the same service transaction
structural/system/required-active dependencies block; classification/default references are soft for unchanged history; inactive owners do not block
each whole child collection is one logical path, each custom-field definition id is a separate path, and links are an endpoint logical path
snapshots include stable child identities, active and inactive state, custom values, and endpoint links but exclude hierarchy and other derived projections
escaped parameterized normalized containment search, typed filters, stable id final sort key, and declared columns
Python, CLI, HTTP, and workbench translation return canonical equal outputs/errors; MCP joins in Row 9

protected profile refs never return or enter audit snapshots; bank suffixes and customer payment brand/last-four are member-visible when later populated; vendor and employee tax suffixes are null below admin; full identifiers and credentials are rejected

customer, vendor, item, fixed-asset, discount-amount, and vendor-profile money is home currency; account amounts use account currency; price-level money uses resolved level currency; mismatch rejects and no implicit conversion occurs
tax, term-discount, and item-discount percent is 0..100; price-level percent is -100..1000000; declared nonnegative quantities and money reject negatives
money excess scale returns E_AMOUNT_PRECISION; malformed or excess-scale non-money returns E_VALIDATION; declared-range or signed-storage overflow returns E_VALUE_RANGE

authorization.enforcement: role thresholds in Row 5; capability names are inert compatibility metadata until Row 7
authorization.role_vocabulary: stored roles are owner, admin, standard, readonly; member is the registry threshold alias for any active membership and is not stored

capability_names.ordinary_lifecycle: exact noun command prefix for each required noun
